needle_fact: The backfill script `scripts/backfill_renewals.ts` used `new Date(year, month, day)` which constructs a Date in the runtime's local timezone. It was executed from a developer laptop set to Asia/Bangkok (UTC+7), so midnight-Bangkok serialized as 17:00 UTC the previous day, making those rows match the scheduler's UTC-midnight comparison seven hours early.
